classification_and_repairs.cause: Ordinary Windows directory File::open(...).sync_all() fails with AccessDenied.
classification_and_repairs.repair: Open only directory-sync handles with read+write+FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS on Windows; retain existing non-Windows path, every sync error, and file identity/reparse validation.
classification_and_repairs.scope: operator acceptance 3 durable failures and shadow qualification 17 failures
classification_and_repairs.tests: Cross-platform write/readback/no-overwrite, missing directory rejection; actual Windows incompatible-sharing handle causes error and release permits sync.

classification_and_repairs.cause: Fixtures invoke /usr/bin/ssh-keygen even before cross-platform policy tests; only two actual signature verification positive paths are production Unix-only.
classification_and_repairs.repair: Shared fixture retains real OpenSSH generation/fingerprint on Unix. Non-Unix constructs a real deterministic Rust Ed25519 public key, canonical SSH blob and SHA256 fingerprint; production policy digest/key/namespace paths remain exercised. Only two Unix verification positives are scoped; non-Unix directly tests the exact unsupported errors plus unchanged trust/challenge trees and no verified signature.

classification_and_repairs.cause: Both require DurablePromptRegistry and FinalUseAuthority; underlying production explicitly returns UnsafeStateDirectory on non-Unix.
classification_and_repairs.repair: Scope exactly those two positive tests and their private fixture-only imports/functions to Unix. Non-Unix executes real registry and authority opens on missing and existing state paths, requires exact UnsafeStateDirectory and compares all original state/sidecar/pointer/tree bytes.

publication: No commit or push by this agent; parent reviews and publishes.
scope_limits: No change to Windows production signature support or Unix secure-owner requirements.
No claim of Windows ACL ownership verification or power-failure durability from directory flush alone.
No Rust dependencies, lockfiles, production sandbox policy or test skip mechanisms changed.

test_execution_contract.reason_no_target_compatibility_change: These existing targets run mixed complete unit suites, not dedicated Unix qualification filters; substantive non-Unix tests remain in the same targets.
test_execution_contract.windows_count_basis: Original logged counts; operator replaces two Unix positives with two exact non-Unix negatives and adds three directory tests; optimizer replaces two owner positives with two exact negatives; shadow adds three directory tests.
